run_steps.name: run-01-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python -m py_compile fix_ttthresh.py test_fix_ttthresh.py && python -m unittest -v test_fix_ttthresh > /out/fix_tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/fix_tests.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-02-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && python fix_ttthresh.py --dest /work/src --reqs /work/requirements.txt > /out/fix.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/fix.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-03-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work/src && python -m py_compile ttthresh_core.py ttthresh_job.py test_ttthresh_core.py > /out/compile.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/compile.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-04-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work/src && python -m unittest -v test_ttthresh_core > /out/tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/tests.txt; exit $rc

run_steps.name: run-05-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work && sha256sum fix_ttthresh.py test_fix_ttthresh.py AMENDMENT-0.1.1.md requirements.txt src/ttthresh_core.py src/ttthresh_job.py src/test_ttthresh_core.py src/PREREG-v0.1.md src/requirements.txt | tee /out/sha256.txt

run_steps.name: run-06-cd
run_steps.cmd: cd /work/src && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 python ttthresh_job.py --data-dir /data --out /out > /out/run.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^TT_' /out/run.txt; tail -n 40 /out/run.txt; exit $rc
